character: The character is a capable merchant captain in her forties with sun-weathered skin, auburn hair in a thick braid and a few freckles. She wears a navy blue double-breasted coat, a loose white shirt and a leather belt with a brass spyglass, one hand on her hip. Sharp grey eyes, a wry half smile.

name: Captain Joaquim Sousa
title: Master of a merchantman
character: The character is a lean Portuguese merchant captain in his thirties with dark curly hair, a neat moustache and gold hoop earrings. He wears a burgundy coat with frayed gold trim over an open-necked shirt and holds a small brass sextant. He looks cautious and clever.

name: Captain Adaeze Okafor
title: Master of a merchantman
character: The character is a striking West African merchant captain in her thirties with high cheekbones, short cropped hair and gold stud earrings. She wears a long teal coat over a cream blouse and a patterned silk sash, with a ledger tucked under one arm. Confident, appraising gaze.

name: Captain Edmund Hale
title: Captain of a navy frigate
character: The character is a tall, stiff naval captain in his forties with a long jaw, powdered grey wig tied with a black ribbon and a hooked nose. He wears a dark blue naval coat with white lapels, gold epaulettes and buttons, and a sword at his hip. Cold, disciplined expression.

name: Lieutenant Clara Vance
title: A navy lieutenant
character: The character is a young naval lieutenant woman in her twenties with fair hair pinned back under a bicorne hat, blue eyes and a determined jaw. She wears a fitted dark blue naval coat with white facings and a single gold epaulette, a pistol in her belt. Eager, earnest, a little proud.

name: Admiral Sir Rufus Blackwood
title: Admiral of the patrol
character: The character is an old admiral in his sixties with a bushy white beard, a scar across one cheek and a heavy gold-laced bicorne hat. He wears a heavily decorated dark blue coat with medals and gold braid and leans on a cane. Gruff, battle-hardened, a twinkle in his eye.

name: A Castaway
title: Taken off the beach
character: The character is a gaunt castaway woman in her thirties with sun-bleached tangled hair, deeply tanned freckled skin and bright desperate eyes. She wears a ragged sleeveless shirt and torn sailcloth trousers tied with rope, a shell necklace, and holds a sharpened stick. Wild, relieved, half laughing.
character_v2: The character is a gaunt castaway woman in her thirties with sun-bleached tangled hair, freckled tanned skin and bright eyes, flintlock era. She wears a ragged faded sky-blue naval coat several sizes too big over a torn linen shirt and sailcloth trousers tied with rope, a shell necklace, and clutches a hand-made spear and a corked message bottle. Laughing and crying with relief.

name: A Castaway
title: Taken off the beach
character: The character is an elderly castaway man in his seventies with a very long white beard, a bald sunburnt head and a gentle face. He wears the faded remains of a naval coat with no sleeves over bare skin, and clutches a battered leather journal. Kindly, dazed, grateful.
character_v2: The character is an elderly castaway man in his seventies with a very long white beard, a sunburnt bald head and a gentle face, flintlock era. He wears a patched, faded scarlet naval officer's coat buttoned over a ragged shirt and a hat woven from palm leaves, and clutches a battered leather journal and a tiny carved wooden ship. Dazed, kindly, grateful.

name: A Castaway
title: Taken off the beach
character: The character is a young castaway man in his twenties, lean and wiry, with a shaggy black beard, a red bandana and a parrot feather tucked behind one ear. He wears a torn striped shirt and ragged trousers, a coconut shell cup in hand. Grinning wildly.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a beautiful young noblewoman in her twenties with dark ringlets coming loose, flushed cheeks and defiant green eyes. She wears a torn pale blue silk gown with lace at the sleeves and a pirate's coat thrown over her shoulders, a broken rope around one wrist. Proud and furious.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a scholarly woman in her forties with grey-streaked hair in a loose bun, round spectacles and ink-stained fingers. She wears a dusty dark green travelling dress and clutches a rolled chart to her chest. Shaken but sharp-eyed and curious.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a tough-looking woman in her thirties with short copper hair, a bruise on one cheek and a split lip, smiling anyway. She wears a ripped white shirt, a leather corset vest and a sailor's trousers, rubbing her freed wrists. Fierce, amused, unbroken.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a young nobleman in his twenties with pale skin, fair hair tied back and a thin moustache, looking hungry and indignant. He wears a stained embroidered silk coat, a torn cravat and one shoe. Pompous but grateful.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a broad-shouldered ship's gunner in his forties with a shaved head, a thick black beard and tattooed forearms. He wears a torn grey shirt and canvas trousers, iron shackles hanging open from his wrists. Grim, strong, ready for revenge.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is a dashing rival captain in her thirties with long wavy black hair, a beauty mark and a confident smirk. She wears a fitted crimson frock coat with gold embroidery, a black tricorn with a white plume and a rapier at her hip. Glamorous, dangerous, enjoying herself.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is a handsome rival privateer in his thirties with sandy hair, a strong jaw, stubble and a scar through one eyebrow. He wears a dark green long coat over an open white shirt, a baldric with two pistols, and a cocky grin.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is an elegant older rival captain in her fifties with silver hair in a severe bun, a monocle and a thin cigarillo. She wears an immaculate black coat with silver buttons and a high collar, black leather gloves. Cool, calculating, faintly amused.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is a huge, jovial rival captain in his forties with a braided red beard decorated with beads, a fur-trimmed coat and a big brass-handled axe on his shoulder. He laughs with his head thrown back. Boisterous and friendly in a threatening way.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is a lithe young rival captain in her twenties with a shaved undercut, a long black braid, kohl-rimmed eyes and gold rings in her ears. She wears a sleeveless leather jerkin over a loose shirt, cutlass in hand. Fearless, cheeky, glamorous.

name: A Rival Captain
title: A rival captain
character: The character is a cold, handsome rival captain in his forties with a sharp grey goatee, slicked-back dark hair and pale eyes. He wears a midnight blue coat with a high collar, a silver skull brooch, and holds a cocked pistol casually. Menacing calm.

name: A Smuggler
title: Running contraband
character: The character is a shifty smuggler in his thirties with a hooded grey cloak, a long nose, quick dark eyes and a gap-toothed grin. Under the cloak a patched waistcoat with too many pockets and a cask of brandy under one arm. Sly, nervous, charming.

name: A Smuggler
title: Running contraband
character: The character is an attractive smuggler woman in her twenties with honey-brown hair under a dark knit cap, freckles and a mischievous smile. She wears a short dark coat, rolled sleeves and a leather satchel stuffed with letters, a knife in her boot. Playful and quick.

name: A Smuggler
title: Running contraband
character: The character is a weathered old smuggler woman in her sixties with a pipe, a black eyepatch and long grey hair in two braids. She wears an oilskin coat over many layers, a lantern hanging from her belt. Knowing, unafraid, amused by everything.

name: A Smuggler
title: Running contraband
character: The character is a sharp-featured smuggler woman in her forties with black hair cut to the jaw, a thin white scar on her chin and dark watchful eyes. She wears a long weathered brown greatcoat with deep pockets over a grey waistcoat, fingerless gloves, and has a coil of rope over one shoulder and a small keg under her arm. Calm, unreadable, quietly dangerous.

name: A Smuggler
title: Running contraband
character: The character is a cheerful plump smuggler woman in her fifties with rosy cheeks, curly grey-blonde hair under a red headscarf and a gold tooth in her grin. She wears a patched blue apron over a striped skirt and a heavy shawl, a basket of 'fish' on her hip with bottles poking out. Innocent face, wicked eyes.

name: A Castaway
title: Taken off the beach
character: The character is a sturdy castaway woman in her forties with greying brown hair hacked short, a sunburnt weathered face and strong arms. She wears a torn and faded red naval jacket with no shirt beneath, wrapped with a sailcloth belt, a long knife made from a barrel hoop and a spyglass with a cracked lens. Grim, capable, hugely relieved.

name: A Castaway
title: Taken off the beach
character: The character is a young castaway girl in her late teens with long wild dark curly hair full of salt, freckled brown skin and wide amazed eyes. She wears a ragged yellowed linen dress cut short at the knee, a necklace of shells and shark teeth, and holds a woven palm-leaf hat. Shy, grateful, curious.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is an elegant older lady in her sixties with silver hair pinned up, a long dignified face and sharp blue eyes behind a lorgnette. She wears a rich plum-coloured travelling gown, slightly torn at the hem, a cameo brooch and a lace shawl, holding a closed parasol like a weapon. Haughty, unshaken, very unimpressed with pirates.

name: Freed Captive
title: Freed from the pirates
character: The character is a young East Asian woman in her twenties, a ship's surgeon, with straight black hair tied back, a calm intelligent face and a smudge of soot on her cheek. She wears a practical dark grey dress with rolled sleeves and a leather apron, a satchel of medical instruments over her shoulder. Composed, kind, resolute.

name: Commander Isobel Thorne
title: Commander of a navy brig
character: The character is a tall naval commander woman in her forties with dark auburn hair in a tight queue under a black bicorne hat, a strong nose and grey eyes. She wears a dark blue naval coat with white lapels and gold buttons, a gold epaulette on one shoulder, a sword belt and a brass telescope tucked under one arm. Stern, fair, utterly in command.

name: Captain Hester Lowe
title: Master of a merchantman
character: The character is a wiry elderly merchant captain woman in her sixties with white hair in a long plait, a deeply lined tanned face and a clay pipe. She wears a faded green coat with brass buttons over a knitted jumper, canvas trousers and sea boots, a battered leather ledger under her arm. Shrewd, salty, kind.
